tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search public BetterLaunch products, active categories and tags. Returns at most 10 summaries of each kind.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get public product details and taxonomy by exact slug. Unknown or withdrawn products return a tool error.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List active BetterLaunch categories with bilingual names, slugs and public product counts, including empty categories.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List active BetterLaunch tags with bilingual names, slugs and public product counts, including unused tags.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Browse public products in one active category or tag, up to 18 per page. Unknown or inactive taxonomy returns a tool error.
